verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows indirect ways to pull data out: an official CLI with an `sf data query` command and general references to Salesforce APIs. Nothing documents a full-data export, open output formats, or a migration-off path. Missing for 10: documented bulk or full-org export, explicit open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON) for exports, coverage of all data types (attachments, metadata), and any independent or hands-on confirmation of leaving with complete data.
